full_judgment: 15. The principles laid down in all the above decisions is that an aggrieved party instead of availing the statutory forum for remedy, may invoke the extraordinary writ jurisdiction of the High Court Division if in the circumstances it can be shown that the alternative/remedy is not likely to be efficacious and effective in the facts and circumstances of the case.
